decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page and fits closely with the core facial care range, so it likely meets the aspiration level in a growing industry and gives management no shortfall to trigger search for other uses of its resources.

A hyaluronic serum is a standard, in-demand item that fits the existing range; although it is only mentioned on the website, low marginal costs from small-batch in-house production let the firm carry it while results remain uncertain.
A cleansing milk is a basic complement to the facial care assortment, and with no signs of performance trouble or pressure to search for alternatives, the firm would routinely keep it.
